draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.36, the 41st-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 7th of 36 at CB. He went 16th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (41st): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Cam Dantzler. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (90th percentile), 10-yard split (93rd percentile), broad jump (80th percentile). College production: 11 passes defended in 2022, 5th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Los Angeles Rams. 39 career games and 22 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (6 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: passes defended 18 (99th percentile), interceptions 3 (92nd percentile), approximate value 6 (88th percentile). Weak spots: missed tackle rate 21.1% (3rd percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 cornerback who played: 72.5% season snap share against a median of 40.4%, above the norm.
